mapper.select: SELECT CAST(s.id AS CHAR) skuId,CAST(p.id AS CHAR) productId,p.name productName, p.description productDescription,p.featured productFeatured,CAST(c.id AS CHAR) categoryId,c.name categoryName, CAST(b.id AS CHAR) brandId,b.name brandName,s.code skuCode,s.specs_json specsJson,CAST(s.price_minor AS CHAR) priceMinor, s.version skuVersion,p.version productVersion,c.version categoryVersion,b.version brandVersion FROM sku s JOIN product p ON p.id=s.product_id JOIN category c ON c.id=p.category_id JOIN brand b ON b.id=p.brand_id WHERE s.enabled = TRUE AND p.state = 'ON_SALE' AND c.enabled = TRUE AND b.enabled = TRUE AND s.id IN CAST(#{id} AS UNSIGNED) ORDER BY s.id
SELECT CAST(s.id AS CHAR) skuId,CAST(s.product_id AS CHAR) productId FROM sku s WHERE s.enabled = TRUE AND s.id IN CAST(#{id} AS UNSIGNED) ORDER BY s.id
SELECT CAST(id AS CHAR) FROM product WHERE id=CAST(#{id} AS UNSIGNED) FOR SHARE
SELECT CAST(id AS CHAR) FROM category ORDER BY id LIMIT 1 FOR SHARE

SELECT CAST(s.id AS CHAR) skuId,CAST(p.id AS CHAR) productId,p.name productName, p.description productDescription,p.featured productFeatured,CAST(c.id AS CHAR) categoryId,c.name categoryName, CAST(b.id AS CHAR) brandId,b.name brandName,s.code skuCode,s.specs_json specsJson,CAST(s.price_minor AS CHAR) priceMinor, s.version skuVersion,p.version productVersion,c.version categoryVersion,b.version brandVersion FROM sku s JOIN product p ON p.id=s.product_id JOIN category c ON c.id=p.category_id JOIN brand b ON b.id=p.brand_id WHERE s.enabled = TRUE AND p.state = 'ON_SALE' AND c.enabled = TRUE AND b.enabled = TRUE AND s.id IN CAST(#{id} AS UNSIGNED) ORDER BY s.id FOR SHARE

SELECT CAST(pa.product_id AS CHAR) productId,CAST(a.id AS CHAR) assetId,a.storage_key storageKey, a.content_type contentType,a.size_bytes sizeBytes FROM product_asset pa JOIN asset a ON a.id=pa.asset_id WHERE a.visibility='PUBLIC' AND a.size_bytes <= 5242880 AND a.content_type IN ('image/jpeg','image/png','image/webp') AND pa.product_id IN CAST(#{id} AS UNSIGNED) ORDER BY pa.product_id,pa.sort_order,a.id FOR SHARE
